charts.title: Regenerated C++ baseline vs the published figure
charts.caption: Normalized fractional-length endpoint per model — teal = Osborne et al. 2017 Fig 3, hollow coral = our regenerated C++ run. Models ordered most-sorted (OS) to least (VT).
charts.interpretation: Every model lands within 0.06 of the published endpoint and the ordering (OS < CP < CA < VM < VT) matches Fig 3 exactly, confirming the build + paper-parameter restoration.
